item.title: Imaging defects in two-dimensional crystals by convergent beam electron diffraction
item.description: arXiv:2610.21542v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Convergent beam electron diffraction (CBED), recently demonstrated on two-dimensional (2D) materials, offers a number of interesting applications such as imaging atomic in- and out-of plane shifts, interlayer distances, and individual adsorbates. In this study, we show how CBED allows for atomic-precision imaging of individual defects in 2D materials using one single-shot intensity measurement.
